full_prompt_en: A square painterly fantasy image shows a young woman seated in profile toward the right against a dark blue and floral background. Her brown hair is gathered at the back with small pale flowers and leaves, and a few loose strands soften the cheek. She looks downward with a calm expression, shoulders slightly rounded and hands resting together near the lap. A delicate dress or bodice is built from cream fabric, green leaves, and pink-white blossoms that cluster across the shoulder and torso. Behind her left shoulder, a broad translucent golden wing rises at a diagonal, its thin veins and warm bronze edge catching the light. The lower half of the figure disappears into pale fabric and shadow near the bottom crop. The background is not a literal garden space; patches of deep navy, gray-blue, crimson, and ocher are swept together like thick oil paint, with a few flowerlike forms emerging from the surface. The brightest area lies around the upper-left shoulder and hair, where cool daylight or studio light enters from the left. It grazes the face, petals, and wing, while the space to the right grows nearly black. Visible brush marks and scraped colors make the setting feel layered and tactile, but the facial profile retains smoother modeling. The wing and floral dress add delicate irregular edges against the dark ground. There is no readable text or architecture. The overall composition is intimate and dreamlike, balancing a still human profile with shimmering natural ornament and a dense, turbulent painted field.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形绘画式幻想图像描绘一位年轻女子朝右侧坐着，背景深蓝且带花卉色块。棕发在后方束起，点着浅花和叶片，几缕碎发柔化脸颊。她低头，神情平静，肩膀微圆，双手在膝边相靠。精致衣裙或胸衣由奶油色织物、绿叶与粉白花组成，在肩和躯干聚集。左肩后，一片宽阔半透明金色翅膀斜向上升，细翅脉和暖铜边接住光。下半身在底部裁切附近消失于浅布和阴影。背景不是字面意义的花园空间；深海军蓝、灰蓝、绯红与赭色斑块像厚油画般扫在一起，少数花样形从表面浮出。最亮处在左上肩与头发附近，冷日光或影棚光从左进入。它擦亮脸、花瓣和翅膀，右侧空间则近乎黑色。可见笔痕和刮擦颜色让环境层叠可触，脸侧面仍保持更平滑的塑形。翅膀与花衣在深底前增加精细不规则边缘。没有可读文字或建筑。整体构图亲密且如梦，以静止人侧影平衡闪动自然装饰和浓密、湍动的绘画色场。
style_prompt_en: The image has romantic painterly fantasy texture with a smoothly modeled focal profile surrounded by thick, broken color and delicate translucent edges. Deep navy, muted blue-gray, burgundy, antique gold, and cream form a rich cool-warm contrast. Floral-looking specks and leafy fragments appear as surface rhythm rather than a fixed setting, while the brightest accents cluster around one side of the central form. Side light catches thin material and raised brush texture, leaving the opposite field nearly black. Soft facial planes and rough scraped background strokes remain visibly distinct. The overall effect is intimate, ornate, and dreamlike.
style_prompt_zh: 图像具有浪漫的绘画式幻想肌理，平滑塑形的焦点侧面被厚重破碎色彩和精细半透明边缘包围。深海军蓝、低饱和灰蓝、酒红、旧金与奶油色形成丰富冷暖对照。花点和叶片般碎形作为表面节奏出现，而非限定固定场景，最亮强调聚在中央形体一侧。侧光抓住薄材料与凸起笔触肌理，让对侧色域近乎黑。柔和面部平面和粗糙刮擦背景笔触保持明显区别。整体效果亲密、繁复且如梦。
theme_en: A flower-adorned woman with translucent wings seated against a dark painterly background
theme_zh: 饰满花朵、带半透明翅膀的女子坐在深色绘画背景前
name: Christy Lee Rogers
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
